title: Popular initiative 'No 10-million Switzerland!' (Sustainability Initiative)
description: SVP popular initiative seeking to limit the permanent resident population (with intermediate thresholds and the prospect of ending the EU free-movement agreement if exceeded). As party president, Dettling was a leading public campaigner for the initiative.

title: Electricity framework act ('Strom-Mantelerlass') referendum position
description: Under Dettling's presidency, the SVP delegates' assembly that elected him also adopted a 'No' position on the federal electricity supply framework act (Mantelerlass).
role: SVP president at the deciding delegates' assembly
status: SVP recommended a No; the act was approved by voters in the June 2024 referendum
